platforms.name: Browser extension (Chromium)
platforms.notes: The packaged zip strips the development key; the Chrome Web Store ID will differ from the unpacked ID. 1.5.1 removes the private-window (incognito) mode from the browser: the popup and options no longer show a private-windows layer, an 'allow in Incognito' guide or its strings. Private browsing is the Mac app's hardening-profile step, which disables it in every configured browser; the extension no longer coaches the person into enabling it. 1.5.0's portable rules and 1.4.0's quiet UI are retained.

platforms.name: Mac
platforms.state: development · unsigned, needs Developer ID and notarization
platforms.notes: Every target must carry the same MARKETING_VERSION and CURRENT_PROJECT_VERSION; 1.1.12 makes browser protection continuous. The guard no longer waits for a lock or for the 'Keep browser protection on' opt-in: while Hisn runs, a browser whose extension stops answering shows a one-minute countdown and is closed, and unsupported browsers (Safari) close too. The outside-lock setting, its confirmation, its setter and its readiness issue are removed, so there is no off switch inside the app. 1.1.11's status hero, Check a website sheet and grouped pages, 1.1.10's pinned lock action and 1.1.9's guard card are retained. Unsigned/unnotarized.

platforms.name: iPhone & iPad
platforms.state: development · no Apple team, Family Controls entitlement or test device
platforms.notes: The app, six Safari blockers, HisnActivityMonitor, the scanner and two shield extensions share one version set. 1.5.0 is a UI/UX pass: the overview is a calm card stack (status, pause, plan progress, lock and rules), the lock, blocked-site and app-limit cards open their editors directly, Setup is three guided steps with a checks card, the app-limit editor shows its three modes as a visible decision, and Settings is grouped cards. 1.4.0's bilingual Screen Time shield with no unlock, 1.3.0's pause, quiet hours and saved-rule freeze, and seed v5's 239,885-domain Safari list are retained. ScreenZen was observed read-only for design vocabulary; no code, assets or copy was reused.

platforms.name: Android
platforms.state: released · signed direct APK on GitHub; Play AAB not uploaded
platforms.notes: versionCode is monotonic and must increase for every uploaded or side-loaded update. 27 (1.1.0) adds a first-run welcome, a voluntary pause on Protection and today's usage in the daily-limit editor; it adds no enforcement layer and relaxes no rule. 1.0.0 added per-app daily foreground-time limits alongside the protection lock, removal guard, managed lockdown, watchdog and bundled-list warning. Release APKs are checked; the release keystore is in the gitignored keys/android and must be backed up offline in two places. The Play AAB is built but not uploaded.
